# Build the dummy Dockerfile
exec docker build -qt dummy-nocase-updater .

# Run the dependabot command
dependabot update -f job.yml --updater-image dummy-nocase-updater --skip-image-verification

# assert the dummy is working
stderr 'case-insensitive storage is working'
stderr 'runtime-security flow=case-insensitive capeff=0000000000000000 nonewprivs=1 seccomp=2'

exec docker rmi -f dummy-nocase-updater

-- Dockerfile --
FROM ubuntu:22.04

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && useradd -m dependabot

COPY --chown=dependabot update-ca-certificates /usr/bin/update-ca-certificates
COPY --chown=dependabot print-security /usr/local/bin/print-security
COPY --chown=dependabot run bin/run
RUN chmod 0755 /usr/bin/update-ca-certificates /usr/local/bin/print-security /bin/run

-- update-ca-certificates --
#!/usr/bin/env bash

echo "Updated those certificates for ya"

-- print-security --
#!/usr/bin/env bash

cap_eff=$(awk '$1 == "CapEff:" { print $2 }' /proc/self/status)
no_new_privs=$(awk '$1 == "NoNewPrivs:" { print $2 }' /proc/self/status)
seccomp=$(awk '$1 == "Seccomp:" { print $2 }' /proc/self/status)
echo "runtime-security flow=$1 capeff=$cap_eff nonewprivs=$no_new_privs seccomp=$seccomp"

-- run --
#!/usr/bin/env bash

if [ "$1" = "fetch_files" ]; then
  # git clone would have created this directory
  mkdir -p "$DEPENDABOT_REPO_CONTENTS_PATH"
  exit 0
fi

echo "test file" > "$DEPENDABOT_REPO_CONTENTS_PATH/test.txt"
if [ -e "$DEPENDABOT_CASE_INSENSITIVE_REPO_CONTENTS_PATH/TEST.TXT" ]; then
  echo "case-insensitive storage is working"
else
  echo "case-insensitive storage is not working"
fi
print-security case-insensitive

-- job.yml --
job:
  experiments:
    use_case_insensitive_filesystem: true
  source:
    provider: github
    repo: test/repo
    directory: /
  package-manager: nuget
